en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing the main entrance of a brick military barracks building. Soldiers stand in front of a large arched gateway with a sentry box to the left. Above the arch is an inscription on the stone, and printed caption text runs along the bottom margin of the image in French and Dutch, identifying the place as the main entrance of the 4th Line Regiment in Bruges.
